name: hardware_ceilings
notes: Wave64 + 256-entry LDS f16vec2 LUT won NVFP4 GEMV sweep.

name: nvfp4_baseline_mtp0
notes: All NVFP4 target weights in VRAM, embeddings pinned in DDR5 (0.86 GiB saved). 2.6x over 24-25 tok/s GGUF baseline.

name: dspark_mtp_49k_initial
notes: DSpark 3-layer draft head + adaptive {2,4,8} Markov gating (0.80) + O(1) PromptLookupIndex.

name: spec_b_and_wave64_route_topk
notes: Eliminated RDNA 3 acc[8] scratch spills via SPEC_B specialization constants; parallel Wave64 sorted route_topk achieved 8.7x router speedup and bit-exact greedy parity.

name: persistent_moe_up_and_uvec4_test
notes: Kept 240-WG zero-barrier subgroupShuffleXor(v,16) SwiGLU moe_up; reverted Uvec4Buf+unpackHalf2x16 after 2.5x router regression.

name: batched_controller_and_fusion_test
notes: Kept 3-stream batched controller_nvfp4 (8.2x speedup, CtrlDesc in ReBAR) + uvec2 sconv_w; reverted 18.5KB LDS post_depth_norm (+1.8ms drain stall) and F16Vec4Buf (16-bit scalar loads).

name: combined_decode_hillclimb_512tok
notes: 512-token code benchmark broke 100 tok/s on RX 7800 XT.

name: wmma_b64_splitk_fix_prefix_cache_server
notes: RDNA 3 WMMA B=64 prefill, 9-VGPR split-K attention (2.25x faster at 65K), 3-slot DDR5 prefix KV cache (11x cached prefill), GPU Gumbel-Max sampling, zero-malloc Winsock2 OpenAI HTTP/SSE server. All quality gates passed.

name: tiled_split_attention_headmajor_q4_rowowner_softmax
notes: One Wave64 per split, 16-token tiles, all B rows x 3 GQA heads share each KV tile; inline rel-bias; head-major Q4 KV; row-owner softmax. Fixed non-monotonic split-count dispatch bug (garbage at ~100K). Reverted: min-tiles 1/2, batched 64-row prefill attention, vec4 PV reads.

name: vram_probe_ddr5_expert_tier_arena_fixes
notes: --expert-tier auto keeps all KV in VRAM by moving tail experts to pinned DDR5 (each token reads all KV but 8/128 experts). Allocate-until-fail VRAM probe (WDDM budget over-reports); arena prefers new VRAM slabs over DDR5 fallback and reuses weight-slab tails.

name: quality_eval_harness_bf16_router
notes: New `score` subcommand + eval/quality.py: teacher-forced log-probs from squid7800xt and llama-server (forced-token logit_bias) on identical token ids. NVFP4 vs UD-IQ4_XS: +1.49% ppl on WikiText-2, tied on HumanEval code. BF16 router (linear_bf16.comp, decode + B=64 prefill): wiki gap +1.49% -> +1.25% (borderline significant), code unchanged, -0.7% mtp=0 decode, MTP within noise.

name: nvfp4_block_scale_search
notes: Load-time packers (BF16->NVFP4 dense/LM head, MXFP8->NVFP4 L20-23 experts) pick each 16-block's E4M3 scale by min squared error over divisors {6,5.5,5,4.5,4} x neighbouring codes (shaders/nvfp4_scale_search.glsl). Perplexity flat (within noise); KL to the independently quantized UD-IQ4_XS drops ~21% (significant), i.e. less quantization noise. Same format/bytes, zero runtime cost.

name: zero_lds_wave64_depth_norm_and_vec_bf16_router
notes: 1-Wave64 zero-LDS zero-barrier depth_norm.comp + 4-Wave64 uvec2 linear_bf16.comp + audit fixes (build.zig header dep, window bootstrap in quality.py, --kv flag).

name: lds_cached_x_linear_nvfp4_and_moe_up
notes: Padded bank-conflict-free LDS s_x in linear_nvfp4 (SPEC_B>=2) and moe_up (B=2 full LDS, B=4 chunked LDS). Reverted 1-wave route_topk (scratch spills) and full-LDS moe_up B=4 (occupancy drop).

name: group32_asymmetric_q4_1_kv_and_fp8_lm_head
notes: Group-32 asymmetric Q4_1 KV cache + per-row FP8 E4M3 LM head (+199 MiB VRAM, 31.57 dB SNR, 1/64-scaled FP16 LUT). Cuts WikiText-2 gap vs UD-IQ4_XS from +1.25% to +0.85% (significant), beats GGUF on HumanEval code (-0.11%), while remaining faster than Exp 13 baseline.
